sources.title: Classroom meta-analysis: retrieval, distributed and interleaved practice
sources.scope_and_limitations: Supports context-dependent use of retrieval, spacing and interleaving; 53 studies / 7,303 learners; moderators matter.

sources.title: Method of loci systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.scope_and_limitations: Adult recall evidence; low/very-low overall evidence quality and high risk of bias; do not oversell or assume adolescent transfer.

sources.title: Contextual interference and motor retention systematic review
sources.scope_and_limitations: Supports examining varied/interleaved practice for motor retention; does not justify universal random practice.

sources.title: Finding Your Way With Map and Compass
sources.scope_and_limitations: Map scale, distance, cardinal directions, bearing and map reading.

sources.title: How to orient map and compass
sources.scope_and_limitations: Compass/map alignment, magnetic declination and metal interference.

sources.title: Hand and Power Tools
sources.scope_and_limitations: Tool condition, guards, clamping, safe handling; workplace context, adapt age-appropriately.

sources.title: Construction tools: general requirements
sources.scope_and_limitations: Tool condition and guarding; not a youth workshop curriculum.

sources.title: Electrical safety foundation
sources.scope_and_limitations: Electrical hazard recognition and escalation; no household mains practice.

sources.title: Child Activity: An Overview
sources.scope_and_limitations: Age-group activity guidance; not a prescription for an individual athlete.

sources.title: Age- and stage-appropriate strength and conditioning
sources.scope_and_limitations: Developmental readiness, motor competency, qualified supervision and youth conditioning.

sources.title: Injury prevention and management in youth sport
sources.scope_and_limitations: Surface checks, technique coaching, warm-up and safe sport context.

sources.title: Smartphone photography guidance
sources.scope_and_limitations: Focus/exposure, grid, natural light, HDR and composition; instructional not controlled efficacy evidence.

sources.title: Leading lines photography
sources.scope_and_limitations: Leading-line composition and viewpoint practice.

sources.title: Voice Disorders Practice Portal
sources.scope_and_limitations: Vocal hygiene, strain signs, hydration and avoiding shouting; not singing pedagogy.

sources.title: Vocal hygiene: caring for your voice
sources.scope_and_limitations: Voice rest, avoid forcing/shouting and strain.

sources.title: How to record and mix vocals
sources.scope_and_limitations: Microphone distance/position consistency and recording practice.

sources.title: Four steps to food safety
sources.scope_and_limitations: Clean, separate, cook, chill; hand hygiene and cross-contamination.

sources.title: Community hand hygiene guidelines
sources.scope_and_limitations: Hand hygiene moments, soap/water and accessible practice.

sources.title: Food product dating
sources.scope_and_limitations: Date-label interpretation is jurisdiction/product-specific; teach label wording and local advice, not US date rules as Bangladesh law.

sources.title: Cleaning products and indoor air quality
sources.scope_and_limitations: Follow product labels, ventilation, never mix cleaning products.

sources.title: Implementation intentions and goal pursuit
sources.scope_and_limitations: If-then planning as a strategy; effect depends on task and context.

sources.title: The Checklist Manifesto / checklist research context
sources.scope_and_limitations: Checklist design as memory/coordination support; avoid substituting checklist compliance for understanding.

sources.title: Rubik’s Cube official beginner guide
sources.scope_and_limitations: Stepwise beginner solve reference; no claim of broad cognitive transfer.

sources.title: Morse code reference
sources.scope_and_limitations: Morse code symbol reference; practice/recognition standards.

sources.title: Speed reading and comprehension evidence overview
sources.scope_and_limitations: Reading speed is constrained by comprehension/eye movement; reject claims of universally doubling speed without loss.

sources.title: Sleep and dream health guidance
sources.scope_and_limitations: Sleep health; no sleep deprivation, alarms or sleep disruption for lucid-dream practice.

sources.title: Locks and locksmithing safety/legal boundaries
sources.source_type: General consumer resource index; not a legal authority for locksport
sources.scope_and_limitations: Not used to infer local legality. Locksport limits in ATHENA are an internal ethical/safety scope restriction; local law must be checked with a guardian and appropriate local authority.

sources.title: Card handling and sleight-of-hand practice
sources.scope_and_limitations: Dexterity practice only; no evidence of broad transfer.

sources.title: Origami instructional reference
sources.scope_and_limitations: Folding sequence instruction; not efficacy evidence.

sources.title: Doomsday algorithm calendar arithmetic reference
sources.scope_and_limitations: Algorithmic explanation; verify independently before using dates.
